name: GENIUS
intro: GENIUS（Generative Fluid Intelligence Evaluation Suite）是一个用于评估统一多模态模型生成式流体智能的基准，重点考察模型在即时上下文中归纳模式、执行临时约束和适应情境知识的能力。
org: Peking University, CUHK, StepFun, PolyU, MSRA
build_method: 人工构建, 专家构建
metric: Rule Compliance, Visual Consistency, Aesthetic Quality
eval_feature: 归纳推理, 约束遵循, 情境适应
scale: 510个样本、3个维度、5个任务、20个子任务
intro_en: GENIUS is a benchmark for evaluating generative fluid intelligence in unified multimodal models. It measures how models induce implicit patterns, execute ad-hoc constraints, and adapt to contextual knowledge in image generation tasks.
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Interleaved Multimodal Context Design
metric_en: Rule Compliance, Visual Consistency, Aesthetic Quality
eval_feature_en: Inductive Inference, Constraint Following, Contextual Adaptation

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2602.11144. GENIUS operationalizes generative fluid intelligence from CHC theory as Implicit Pattern Induction, Ad-hoc Constraint Execution, and Contextual Knowledge Adaptation. Its 510 expert-curated samples are distributed 86/213/211 across those dimensions and organized into five generation tasks and 20 subtasks. Each item uses interleaved multimodal context whose modalities are jointly necessary, deliberately suppressing semantic shortcuts and memorized priors; experts also annotate task-specific evaluation hints. Unified multimodal models generate images from the context. The hybrid Gemini-3-Pro judge compares output, references, and hints, including a pixel-identity plagiarism check where relevant. Rule Compliance, Visual Consistency, and Aesthetic Quality are each scored 0/1/2 and combined with weights 6:3.5:0.5; an exact reference copy receives zero for Visual Consistency.
